title: Statement of transaction (CDSL DP, SOT_EXP)
when: On request (EOD or for a period)
purpose: Each BO's transactions with the position booked (free, pledged, lock-in …), the narration and the counter account, for a period.
linked: Checked and kept (the COD export is what loads the DP transaction register)
source: CDSL UDiFF Catalogue V3.0.1.4, sheet Field Master, information type Statement_of_transaction (42 fields; names, types and standard values); header and values checked against CDSL's sample file SOT_EXP_041400_104_B_202512311336_5_C_1304140006514184_0_P0.csv (4 rows)
